# FG-CLI-0008

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 504 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `merge_wait_that_times_out_is_retryable` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 待ち時間内に処理が終わりませんでした。処理はサーバーで続いています。しばらくしてから状態を確認してください。
- en: The operation did not finish within the wait time. It continues on the server; check its status later.
- id: Operasi tidak selesai dalam waktu tunggu. Operasi tetap berjalan di server; periksa statusnya nanti.

## 原因 (cause)

`gstn … --wait` (M3 R4: `gstn mr merge --wait`, `gstn mr merge-status --wait`) polled the server until `--wait-timeout` passed and the operation was still not final (a merge still `queued`, `prepared` or `executing`). Nothing was cancelled: the server's job goes on. Retryable (exit code 6).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The detail line carries `reason=merge_not_final` and the last `state`. Read the attempt with `gstn mr merge-status --project ID --iid N --json`; an attempt that stays `executing` is runbook merge-execution.

## 対処 (fix)

Run `gstn mr merge-status --project ID --iid N --wait` again (or with a longer `--wait-timeout`).
